metas.name: ★ 9.4 · 2026 · Wanted
metas.description: Hyun-jun, an ordinary postman, is mistakenly arrested as a wanted criminal due to his identical appearance to fugitive Choi Cheol-gu. While struggling to prove his innocence, the real Cheol-gu escapes prison and flees to Taiwan. When Hyun-jun travels there on a reward trip, he is once again mistaken for the criminal and even kidnapped, only to be rescued by tough detective Woo-hee and her partner. As repeated mix-ups lead to comedic chaos, Hyun-jun and Woo-hee grow closer and ultimately team up to catch the real fugitive together.

metas.name: 2026 · The Last Sunrise
metas.description: A young American woman with health challenges finds unexpected romance with a charismatic local during her summer in Majorca, forcing her to weigh her heart's desires against family obligations and her planned return home.

metas.name: ★ 7.2 · 2026 · My Bias, My Boss
metas.description: A romantic comedy about Nam Da Reum, who joins a company led by former idol-turned-CEO Lee Chan, and unexpectedly finds herself in a romance with the company's boss, Kang Ha Gi.

metas.name: 2026 · Love of Your Life
metas.description: Maya, a smart, wry nurse, is swept up in an immersive love, that sets her life on a trajectory she never would have imagined.

metas.name: ★ 9.1 · 2026 · Comrade Kalyan
metas.description: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · The Prosecutor's Proposal
metas.description: A prosecutor and an investigator linked by a decades-old murder uncover corruption while battling an attraction they cannot resist.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2026 · Take Charge of My Heart
metas.description: A man whose artificial heart is running out of battery and a woman who has the power to recharge him.
